name: Arribes
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Castile and León DO in the southwest of Zamora and northwest of Salamanca, on the Duero River along the Portuguese border. The area is part of a natural park. Allowed grapes include local reds such as Juan García, Rufete and Bruñal, plus Tempranillo and Garnacha Tinta.
